reasons: The run correctly identified the conflict: multi-response Form Fill actions cannot map into incident metadata per product rules, and even a single shared field would suffer overwrite/data-loss across three submissions

Rather than silently picking a resolution, it explained the conflict clearly in forms.md and the chat response, then proposed a concrete alternative (three single-response actions each writing to its own field, plus a human review/selection step) as a recommendation, not a silent choice
Open decisions (D1, D3, D4) are explicitly tracked as unresolved with owners, and D2 is noted as resolved separately, showing a clear separation of confirmed facts vs. open decisions

The response does not claim any live validation against a real Provia org (mode is 'disconnected', tenantId null) and frames Angola/AOA/English as provisional assumptions since no country was given, matching the shared rule against inventing org context
The final response ends with a concrete, scoped next-step recommendation (provia-organization-rollout) with a copyable invocation, satisfying the next-step requirement
The workflow.yaml and provia-project.json artifacts are consistent with the described resolution (quote_1/2/3_amount fields separate from purchase_amount, selected_supplier field for the review step)
